summary: Provider auth matrix contract for desktop/web e2e lane coverage. Support=covered now, deferred=known coverage gap, unsupported=explicitly out of product auth support.

auth_modes.description: Managed subscription sign-in flow (OAuth/device code/token callback).
Endpoint/API-key auth configured in harness source config.
Import existing host auth material into ctx-managed provider auth state.
Create workspace without auth, configure auth later, then run first successful turn.

assertion_definitions.install_success: Managed/provider runtime installation succeeds for the requested execution target.
assertion_definitions.probe_success: Provider verify/probe reports status=ok for the workspace/provider cell.
assertion_definitions.model_list_population: Provider options include at least one resolved model id after auth configuration.
assertion_definitions.first_turn_success: A first user turn reaches completed terminal status with non-empty assistant output.
assertion_definitions.auth_import_success: Auth import flow stores a usable managed credential profile and selects it active.
assertion_definitions.configure_later_connect_success: Configure-later path transitions from no-auth to verified/authenticated state before first turn.
assertion_definitions.unsupported_contract: Cell is intentionally unsupported and must be reported as unsupported (not silently skipped).
